meta.title: EasyPark | Real-time parking management
meta.description: EasyPark connects drivers looking for a space with operators who need to control occupancy, revenue and reports from one place.

hero.subtitle: EasyPark connects drivers looking for a space with operators who need to control occupancy, revenue and reports from one place.

about.title: A team focused on solving an everyday problem
about.desc: EasyPark is an ApexCode project that makes finding parking easier in busy urban areas and gives operators digital tools to run their lot with real-time data instead of notebooks and paper tickets.
about.mission: Provide an accessible solution that makes parking management easier and reduces the time drivers spend looking for a space.
about.vision: Become a leading platform for digital urban parking management, helping drivers and operators use spaces in a more organized and reliable way.
about.noteText: of research and validation with real users

benefits.title: One platform, two experiences
benefits.subtitle: Choose your profile to see how EasyPark helps you from day one.
benefits.d1Desc: Find available parking near your destination, with distance and free spaces at a glance.
benefits.d2Desc: Compare price, distance and features before deciding. No surprise charges when you leave.
benefits.d3Desc: Secure your space before you leave home and get instant confirmation.
benefits.d4Desc: Get notified before your time runs out to avoid extra charges.
benefits.a1Desc: Register, organize and classify your spaces by zone and user type, and update capacity instantly.
benefits.a2Desc: Record entries and exits by QR code or manually, without notebooks or paper tickets.
benefits.a3Desc: Detect overstays and critical capacity without walking the lot.
benefits.a4Desc: Check occupancy, movements and revenue from anywhere and export your reports.

steps.title: Booking your space takes less than a minute
steps.subtitle: This is how the advance booking flow works in the app.
steps.s1Desc: Compare price, distance and available spaces near your destination.
steps.s2Desc: Set the day, start time, estimated duration and your vehicle's plate.
steps.s3Desc: Review the estimated total and confirm. You'll get a confirmation instantly.
steps.s4Desc: Show your code at the entrance; your space is already reserved.

ctaBanner.title: Stop circling around looking for parking
ctaBanner.subtitle: Check real availability before you leave and arrive with your space secured.

features.title: Everything you need, in one platform
features.subtitle: Select a feature to see what it solves.
features.tab1Desc: Filter parking lots by availability, rate and distance, and compare them side by side before choosing.
features.tab2Desc: Schedule date, time and duration, review the estimated total and get confirmation in one step.
features.tab2P2: Cancel while the booking hasn't started
features.tab2P3: History and status of every booking
features.tab3Desc: Staff record entries and exits by QR code or manually; occupancy updates instantly.
features.tab4Desc: Organize your lot into zones and classify each space by user type: customers, subscribers, staff or delivery.
features.tab4P3: Rate and allowed time per zone
features.tab5Desc: Operators get overstay and critical-capacity alerts; drivers get time-remaining and expiration reminders.
features.tab6Desc: Review occupancy, movements, revenue and stay times by period and zone, and export the results.

iot.title: Progressive integration with IoT sensors
iot.desc: You don't need sensors to use EasyPark: run your lot with digital records from day one and, when your volume justifies it, add occupancy sensors to detect free spaces automatically.
iot.chip: Optional · Not required to get started

overview.title: EasyPark: less circling around, more control over your lot
overview.desc: EasyPark is a web platform that connects the daily operation of small and medium parking lots with the information drivers need. Every entry, exit or booking updates the availability users see, without requiring specialized hardware to get started.
overview.p1: Open network: independent parking lots from different operators in one place.
overview.p2: Reliable availability: generated by the parking lot's own operation.
overview.p3: Progressive adoption: start with digital records and add IoT sensors when you need them.

faq.title: We answer your questions
faq.q1: Do I need to install sensors to use EasyPark?
faq.a1: No. You can operate with digital records from day one and add IoT sensors later.
faq.a2: Yes. Driver accounts are free: searching, comparing and booking have no extra cost.
faq.a3: Yes. From “My bookings” you can cancel your active booking before its start time.
faq.a4: The system compares the recorded entry time with the allowed time the operator configured for each zone.
faq.q5: Can I use EasyPark on my phone?
faq.a5: Yes. The web app is responsive and works on computers, tablets and phones, with nothing to install.

legal.tos1: By accessing EasyPark you accept these terms. EasyPark is an academic project developed by the ApexCode team at Universidad Peruana de Ciencias Aplicadas (UPC) and is not, for now, a commercial service.
legal.tos2: EasyPark lets drivers search, compare and book parking spaces, and lets operators record access, manage zones and spaces, receive alerts and review reports.
legal.tos3: You are responsible for keeping your credentials confidential and for the accuracy of the data you register, including your vehicles' plates.
legal.tos4: A booking is confirmed only if availability exists when it is registered. It can be cancelled while it hasn't started. Rates are set by each operator.
legal.tos5: EasyPark acts as an information intermediary. Vehicle custody and the parking service itself are the responsibility of each parking lot.
legal.tos6: We may update these terms. The current version will be published on this page with its update date.
legal.pr1: Name, email, vehicle plates, bookings, access movements and, if you allow it, your approximate location to show nearby parking.
legal.pr2: We use the data to manage your account, process bookings, record access, send service notifications and produce aggregated reports for operators.
legal.pr3: Processing follows Peru's Personal Data Protection Law (Law No. 29733) and its regulations.
legal.pr4: You can exercise your rights of access, rectification, cancellation and objection (ARCO) by writing to contacto@easypark.pe.
legal.pr5: We apply technical measures such as encrypted communication (HTTPS) and token-based authentication to protect your information.
legal.pr6: This site does not use cookies or store data in your browser.
